motion.method: Opened all 40 retained PNGs in frame order; judged action sequences alongside rendered-bounds measurements for every frame 18 through 370, contact/typing boundary tests and reverse-seek PNG equality. This was sequence inspection, not real-time playback.
motion.notes: Approach, contact, preparation, attached drag, release and settled reading are staged separately. Warm paper surfaces, two window elevations, legible Plex type and one rust focus accent serve the task rather than a card template. No remaining blocking visual defect was found in this evidence. Sequence sampling and numeric trajectories are not a universal aesthetic guarantee.

sound.notes: No subjective listening was available. Full exported AAC decode: stereo 48000 Hz; per-channel peak 0.0784912109375; stereo RMS 0.0034335117042996093. All ten planned original material/contact cues correlate across their complete intervals (0.953033 to 0.985930), encoded offsets at most 0.01 frame. All four planned quiet intervals measure RMS zero. Recipes and differing contact hashes are retained. These checks establish signal, identity, timing and headroom, not realism, pleasantness or mix balance by ear. Listening remains pending. No narration or music.

human.notes: The approved acceptance-exercise brief does not require human editorial approval. None has been supplied or inferred.

findings.description: Previous candidates placed the visible cursor 56 pixels below its data coordinates because its absolute positioning inherited a static origin beneath the menu bar. Click and title-bar contact were visibly wrong.
findings.correction: Set explicit left:0 and top:0 on #pointer; strengthened the test to compare actual rendered bounds with the target and grip, not just dataset values. The new test failed at 319 versus expected 263 before the fix, then passed. Rerendered this source and opened every new capture.
findings.limits: Prior candidates and findings remain preserved as diagnostics; they are not approved exports. Current checks cover this scripted geometry at its declared delivery resolution.

findings.description: Subjective listening of the complete export and isolated critical moments has not occurred.
findings.correction: A listener should hear the full film at normal speed, then press/release, typing, grip/drag/drop and transition moments, and record realism, harshness, repetition, balance and picture sync. Keep Gate B partial and delivery technically-verified until that review exists.
findings.limits: Measured correlation, headroom and silence are not hearing. No claim of full creative or human approval is made.
